leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a binary tree node class with left and right child references
Initialize arrays to store inorder and preorder traversal data
Implement a recursive function to build binary trees from traversal sequences
Manipulate array indices to track subtree boundaries during construction
Apply base case conditions to handle empty subtree scenarios
Integrate traversal data with recursive tree-building logic
Render the constructed tree structure for verification
